tasks.one_line: Sound, real (if light) commission; only fix is binding each thumbnail to its specific approved title so the OCR check is answerable — near ready.

tasks.task_name: NIGHTFORM - Low Beam music release package
tasks.brief_note: A music-release package (teaser + vertical + cover) is genuine, hard freelance work and the brief is well written. The problem is not the brief but that the assets cannot fulfill it.
deliverable_issues: Teaser (16:9, 20-30s, audio:music, authored_animation:false) and vertical (9:16, 12-15s, music) are unproducible: the pack has ONE 5.042s silent clip (0 audio streams, 0 audio files). Building a 20-30s live edit from 5s requires looping, which the brief explicitly forbids, and there is no cleared track though the brief says one 'must be supplied before the edit begins'.
Only the 1200x1200 cover + its editable source are cleanly producible.
readiness.release is 'held' with explicit blockers naming the missing audio and coverage — the task itself concedes it is not ready.
verifier_issues: Human checks 'picture rhythm responds to the supplied track' and 'excerpt ends on a coherent musical phrase' reference a track that does not exist in the pack, so they are unanswerable.
Auto duration_range 20-30s cannot be satisfied from 5s of source without looping.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: task_specific_issue: 'a silent five-second visual cannot evaluate music edit rhythm or phrase endings' — confirmed, this is the core defect.
asset_repairs: supply licensed/approved release audio, usable performance coverage and exact release copy — confirmed, these are exactly the gaps.
chatgpt_flags_refuted: silent_audio_conflict=false is under-flagged: the teaser/vertical human checks DO assume music the 0-audio pack lacks, which is a real audio-vs-pack conflict even if it's music rather than speech.
ChatGPT's own proposed repair (a '4-second-or-shorter edit') silently contradicts the shipped 20-30s teaser spec and never reconciles the two.
missed_issues: Brand narrative claims a 'forty five second night take' but the actual asset metadata is a single 5.042s clip — an input inconsistency ChatGPT did not surface.
Footage is grossly insufficient for a no-loop live-action edit at the specified durations.
tasks.one_line: Real brief, but teaser and vertical cannot be produced from a silent 5-second, no-audio pack without breaking the brief's own rules; verifiers reference a track that isn't there.

tasks.task_name: Emberline - Food channel thumbnail and motion package
tasks.brief_note: Large, genuine daily-TV commission: voiced promo + vertical + thumbnail + a 9-card data-merge segment deck bound to a CSV rundown. Substantial multi-artifact work with real repeatability constraints.
deliverable_issues: The 9 segment cards (CSV row-bound) and the thumbnail are strong, real, producible outputs.

But the programme promo (audio:speech, 20-30s) and vertical promo (speech, 12-15s) are unproducible: the pack has ONE 5.042s silent clip and NO host-voice WAV, while the human check demands 'the complete spoken host introduction is audible without missing words' and the brief bans inventing documentary speech.
So 2 of 4 delivery groups are broken; the other 2 are excellent.
verifier_issues: Card checks ('printed Segment Name matches the authoritative record exactly', 'card content matches the segment') are cleanly scoreable against emberline_cards.csv.
Promo speech checks are unanswerable because no audio exists in the pack.
44 human checks across 14 outputs is a heavy expert-scoring burden.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=true (H5: 'the host's voice reads clearly over the room') — confirmed; the pack has no host audio.
task_specific_issue: 'one silent five-second clip cannot meet the voiced programme brief' — confirmed.

So the generic-template defect does not apply to the current deliverables.
missed_issues: Card r002 (Market Open) has an empty Picture field; the 'card content matches the segment' verifier does not specify how the blank picture well should be handled.
Approx Time values across rows are inconsistently formatted (9:00 am / 9.40 / ~10:30 / 14:30 / 4 pm) — fine as verbatim raw rows but worth a reconciliation note.

tasks.task_name: Halden Diaries - Season recap video package
tasks.brief_note: Nuanced, genuinely hard editorial commission: a season recap that preserves an intimate supplied voiceover, a vertical cut, three episode covers, and a hand-painted HALDEN wordmark recovered from a board photo. Real craft judgment required.
deliverable_issues: Producible: the pack supplies halden_recap_vo.wav (28.11s), satisfying the 'complete spoken voiceover audible' check, and 8 episode masters (40.34s) for a 30-45s recap — tight but workable.
Three covers are bound to episodes by output name (Episode 1/2/3), so 'episode title matches the approved copy' is answerable against halden_episode_copy.txt.
No proof-sheet inflation; editable source is genuinely commissioned.
verifier_issues: Only 7 human checks across 6 outputs — clean, low burden, answerable.

recap-tall has acceptance_requirements:[] — its only hard human check is 'no blank frame >1s'; the 'narrative remains coherent' requirement is soft/expert-review only, leaving the vertical without a binding acceptance gate beyond format.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=false is correct here: a real 28.11s voiceover WAV is supplied.
proposed_client_outputs (coherent recap + voice mix + cover system) match the shipped structure.
chatgpt_flags_refuted: ChatGPT's current_deliverables describe a single '24-second-or-shorter edit' plus separate grade/wordmark proof sets — that is the pre-repair framing; the shipped spec is a clean 2-video + 3-cover package and no longer matches that description.
missed_issues: recap-tall carries no hard acceptance_requirements (format-only gate).
8-clip / 40.3s coverage for a 30-45s recap is tight and is itself a live readiness blocker.
tasks.one_line: One of the two strongest tasks: real brief, VO supplied, producible; just confirm 40s of coverage supports 30-45s and give recap-tall a hard acceptance check.

tasks.task_name: Anvil and Oak Strength - Movement coaching clip library

Per-movement footage (~5s x 2-3 takes) for a 15-25s single-rep demo is tight and is flagged as a live coverage blocker.
No proof-sheet inflation and no editable-source padding.
verifier_issues: Human cue/rep/framing checks are answerable against the CSV and VO; 30 human checks across 12 outputs is reasonable.
checks_per_output 13/14/14 looks high but is driven by cheap auto byte checks (format/dims/codec/duration/pixfmt/audio-stream), not expert burden.

silent_audio_conflict=false is correct: a 107.0s coaching-cue VO is supplied for the speech requirement.
chatgpt_flags_refuted: ChatGPT's current_deliverables (a single '24-second-or-shorter edit from 14 clips' + 6 poster frames) describe the broken pre-repair version; the shipped 12-output-with-CSV-bindings spec supersedes it.

Per-movement footage sufficiency for a full 15-25s single-rep demo is unconfirmed (the coverage blocker applies clip-by-clip, not just in aggregate).

tasks.task_name: Vitale Labs - Wellness editorial video package
tasks.brief_note: Genuinely hard, industry-standard commission: a regulatory-sensitive DTC-supplement editorial video series where captions must not introduce a stronger health claim and the presenter's qualification must survive the cut. Real specialist craft (claim-compliance, attribution), not a toy or single atomic op.
deliverable_issues: 6 speech-led films (audio:'speech') with a human check 'The complete spoken speech is audible without missing words', but input_audit shows 6 video files, 0 with audio streams, 0 separate audio files - no spoken material exists in the pack (balance_captions.txt is text only). Speech-led output cannot be built honestly from silent sources.

Footage grossly insufficient: 6 exports each 25-40s, authored_animation=false (live action, looping forbidden), from 30.252s of total raw footage. ~150-240s of distinct footage is needed; only ~30s exists.

Output CLASSES themselves are real finished films (not proof sheets / generic templates); the defect is asset provisioning, which the readiness itself concedes (release:held; 'Supply actual speech and transcripts plus adequate presenter coverage').
verifier_issues: 78 atomic (66 auto / 12 human); checks_per_output 12/14/14 - auto battery is binary and clean (exists/decodes/width/height/duration/codec).
Human audio check is well-worded and answerable in isolation, but is unsatisfiable given the silent pack - the problem is upstream (unbuildable), not check wording.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=true (no audio exists despite complete-audible-sentence human checks)
task_specific_issue: audible-sentence checks with no audio; six-cut expectations need reconciling
chatgpt_flags_refuted: generic_template_groups=[] and support_proof_groups=[] are correctly empty - no refutation needed, ChatGPT did not over-flag here
missed_issues: ChatGPT under-states the footage shortfall: 30.25s total cannot yield six 25-40s live-action films even if audio were fixed. Its proposed D01/D02 rescope quietly abandons the 6-film speech deliverable rather than naming duration as a hard blocker.
tasks.one_line: Strong regulatory-editorial brief and real film deliverables, but unbuildable as specified: speech-led films with zero speech audio in the pack and ~30s of footage for six 25-40s live-action cuts.

tasks.task_name: Pulsevault - Event recap package
tasks.brief_note: Real freelance commission: post-event club-night recap plus cover and next-event story, with a hard specialist sub-task (recover a reusable wordmark from a single floodlit photo of a wall-painted mark, hold it on a near-black cover). Solid, standard-but-genuine social package.
deliverable_issues: recap is music-led (audio:'music') but the pack has no music track (11 clips, 0 audio streams, 0 separate audio). A cleared/generated music bed must be supplied - a milder, creative gap (music is not a factual 'invention' the truth-constraints forbid).
Cover + story + two editable-source ZIPs are legitimate finished outputs and correctly reusable (the lineup card reprints monthly). No proof-sheet or generic-template padding.
Footage is ADEQUATE here: 53.462s across 11 clips for one 20-30s recap - unlike the sibling MOTION tasks.
verifier_issues: 34 atomic (25 auto / 9 human); checks_per_output 5/5/13. Human checks are clean binary and answerable: OCR event identity, date matches next-date file, ticket action in the geometric safe area, source opens in app, text editable independently.
'The sequence represents the supplied event' is mildly soft but answerable (are these this night's supplied clips - yes/no).
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: Residual real gap: a music-led film needs a cleared music bed the pack does not contain
chatgpt_flags_refuted: silent_audio_conflict as framed via H4 ('the host's announcement of the next date is intelligible over the room') is overstated: the v4 deliverable is music-led with a VISUAL final-card date, and no host-speech-intelligibility check appears in the v4 human sample - the conflict looks already reconciled out.
task_specific_issue 'host announcement is scored' is not evidenced in the v4 verifier sample.
tasks.one_line: The most buildable of the five - adequate footage and clean, scoreable checks; only real gap is sourcing a cleared music bed for the music-led recap, and ChatGPT's host-speech conflict appears already fixed.

tasks.task_name: Velvet Hour - Social film and story cutdowns
tasks.brief_note: Concept is a real, hard commission (intimate jazz/folk night: performance-led social film + story cut + A2 next-show poster, with billing order and act attribution treated as strictly as atmosphere). The brief writing is good; the problem is that it references supplied assets that do not exist in the pack.
deliverable_issues: Brief explicitly says 'work from the supplied performance audio and picture, with their synchronisation intact' - but input_audit shows 1 video file, 5.042s, 0 audio streams, 0 separate audio. There is NO supplied performance audio: the brief contradicts the asset pack.

Single 5.04s silent clip cannot produce a 20-30s music/performance film PLUS a 12-15s story cut without looping (explicitly forbidden). Two of the three primary deliverables are unbuildable from the pack.
The A2 poster PDF + editable source ZIP are bespoke, real, and buildable from the lineup CSV + printer card + lampbox mark.
verifier_issues: 37 atomic (30 auto / 7 human); checks_per_output 5/12/13. Human checks are clean and answerable: act identifier matches source exactly, main performer in frame, OCR next-show action, billing order matches lineup, show date matches exactly, source opens/text editable.
'The featured performance remains coherent' is an expert_review criterion (not a pass/fail human check) so its softness is acceptable.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=true (brief demands supplied performance audio that does not exist)
task_specific_issue: one silent five-second clip cannot establish a phrase-complete performance edit
chatgpt_flags_refuted: generic_template_groups=['Poster and social set as one editable document plus its source'] is MISATTRIBUTED: that names ChatGPT's OWN proposed D03 Adobe-Express-template rescope, not a v4 deliverable. The actual v4 poster is a bespoke A2 PDF with a source ZIP - there is no generic-template group in the v4 deliverable list.
missed_issues: The direct brief-versus-assets contradiction ('supplied performance audio and picture with synchronisation intact' against a pack with zero audio) is a spec-integrity defect ChatGPT only gestures at via the generic silent-audio flag.
tasks.one_line: Good commission concept undercut by a brief that cites supplied performance audio the pack lacks and a lone 5s silent clip that cannot fill a 20-30s film plus a 12-15s story cut.

tasks.task_name: Milepost Driving Academy - Scenario clip training library
tasks.brief_note: Best-specified brief of the five: a safety-critical driver-ed training library, 8 distinct scenario clips each bound to a real CSV row with full step copy (e.g. 11-step left-turn-across-traffic, 9-step parallel park) plus a vertical example. Narration and labels must agree with cleared instruction copy. Genuinely hard, high-stakes, industry-standard work.
deliverable_issues: 9 speech-led clips with human checks 'the narration matches the visual scenario' / 'the complete spoken instruction is audible', but input_audit shows 8 video files, 0 audio streams, 0 separate audio - no narration exists. Step TEXT exists in the CSV, so authorised synthetic speech (TTS) could arguably fill it, but the brief's 'cleared narration are prerequisites' leaves that authorisation ambiguous.

Footage cannot depict the manoeuvres: 8 scenario takes total 40.336s (~5s each) for eight 20-35s clips that must show a multi-stage manoeuvre 'without omitting a necessary stage'. A ~5s take cannot depict an 11-step or 9-step manoeuvre; each scenario needs its own adequate coverage.
Deliverable classes are real finished training films bound to data rows (no template/proof padding).
verifier_issues: 125 atomic (99 auto / 26 human) - heaviest set of the five; checks_per_output 13/14/14. Auto battery is binary and fine, but 26 human checks is a large expert-scoring burden.

'The manoeuvre is shown without omitting a necessary stage' is effectively COMPOUND (bundles up to 11 discrete stages into one Yes/No), so it is not cleanly atomic and is demanding to adjudicate per clip.
The three human checks per clip (stage completeness / narration-video match / copy agreement) all require watching the full clip against the CSV steps - answerable, but high-effort.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=true (no narration audio for speech-led training clips)
chatgpt_flags_refuted: task_specific_issue calls this 'a generic recap specification' and ChatGPT's D01 rescope collapses the 8 distinct scenarios into one '24-second-or-shorter edit' - that mischaracterizes the task, which is a per-scenario library bound to individual CSV rows, not a recap. Collapsing it would destroy the training value.
missed_issues: The per-scenario footage/depiction gap: 8x~5s takes cannot show 20-35s multi-stage manoeuvres 'without omitting a necessary stage'. ChatGPT's recap framing hides this by assuming a single montage.
The compound nature of the stage-completeness human check and the sheer 26-check human burden.
tasks.one_line: Excellent data-bound training brief, but speech-led clips have no narration audio and ~5s takes cannot depict 20-35s multi-stage manoeuvres; the checks are also the heaviest and partly compound.

tasks.task_name: FOLD and GRAIN Studio - Dual-client sizzle and service package
tasks.brief_note: Complex, genuinely hard commission: a productized studio's dual-client showcase (Cobbleway bright/warm vs Lunara cool/restrained kept strictly distinct) plus the studio's own service page - films, verticals, campaign boards and a web comp. Rich, layered brand-separation brief, clearly non-toy.
deliverable_issues: Lunara has NO video source: assets list one take only (cobbleway_take_4k.mov) and 12 Lunara still grabs. The Lunara campaign film (20-30s) and Lunara vertical (12-15s), both authored_animation=false live action, have zero motion source - 2 of the 4 films are unbuildable.
Cobbleway coverage is thin: 2 video files total 10.084s (~5s each) for four films needing 64-90s of distinct footage; looping is forbidden.
All 4 films are music-led with no music track in the pack.
The 2 campaign boards (4pp PDF), the service-page comp (1440x2400 PNG) and the source ZIPs ARE bespoke, real, buildable finished outputs from the grabs + service copy - not templates/proofs.
verifier_issues: 75 atomic (64 auto / 11 human); checks_per_output 5/6/12. Human checks are mostly clean binary: product matches identity-defining features in source, board uses actual final campaign frames, service offer follows approved copy, two client examples clearly distinct, source opens / text editable.
'The client identity is recognisable / matches identity-defining features in the supplied reference' is mildly subjective but still answerable.
chatgpt_flags_confirmed: silent_audio_conflict=true (music-led films, no music/no audio in pack)
task_specific_issue: coverage too narrow for the claimed complex engagement
chatgpt_flags_refuted: generic_template_groups=['Cobbleway and Lunara shot boards plus the FOLD & GRAIN service page, as one editable document with its source'] is MISATTRIBUTED: that is ChatGPT's OWN proposed D03 Adobe-Express-template rescope, not a v4 deliverable. The actual v4 boards (4pp PDFs) and service page (1440x2400 web comp) with source ZIPs are bespoke - no generic-template group exists in the v4 list.
missed_issues: ChatGPT frames the gap as 'two four-second sizzles too narrow', which wrongly assumes BOTH clients have a clip. Only Cobbleway has video; Lunara has none - so the Lunara film + vertical have no source at all, a more specific and severe defect than 'too narrow'.
tasks.one_line: Strong dual-brand commission with real bespoke boards/service page, but Lunara has zero video source, Cobbleway offers ~10s for four films, and all four music-led films have no music - the film half is unbuildable.
